w: During the evening assembly the Mayor of Edison -Mr. George Spadaro, Mayor of Franklin - Mr. Upendra Chivukula and other dignitaries and devotees welcomed and honored Swamishri.

Senior Citizens' Din The Southwest Satsang Mandal held a Senior Citizen's Day to give all elderly devotees an opportunity to offer their devotion to God. Senior Citizens got together to sponsor various activities throughout the day, including all meals and parayans, for which they received blessings from Swamishri.

Yashwantbhai Amin phoned from Chicago. Since Yashwantbhai holds a very high position, Pramukh Swami Maharaj kept addressing him as "Saheb, Saheb". Hearing this, Yashwantbhai said, "It does not feel right that you call me Saheb, Saheb. I am a servant, I am your servant."
Swamishri said, "Seva is to be done only by becoming the servant of servants. My blessings that seva is done in the spirit of a servant."
Kanubhai Patel (CEO) phoned from America. His call came after Guru Purnima, so he said, "Late Guru Purnima Jai Swaminarayan."
Pramukh Swami Maharaj said, "When we worship God, do seva and do devotion, we are never late."

Kanubhai Patel (CEO) phoned from America. His call came after Guru Purnima, so he said, "Jai Swaminarayan for a late Guru Purnima."
Pramukh Swami Maharaj said, "When we do Bhagwan's bhajan, do seva and do devotion, we are never late."
Today, after finishing his puja, as Mahant Swami Maharaj was taking his medicine, Gunsagardas Swami said:
"Yesterday, while walking, you gave blessings to Jagdishbhai, and he has passed away to Akshardham, but the whole sequence of events that happened is worth knowing.
At half past two in the afternoon, Jagdishbhai was sitting on the sofa with his wife. After a while he began to say, 'Mahant Swami Maharaj has come and I am going.'
His wife, startled, asked, 'Why are you saying this? Sit down, I will bring water.' And by the time she came back with the water, Jagdishbhai had already lost consciousness.
He was immediately admitted to hospital. You blessed him at 6.00 while walking, and by 6.20 you had taken him."
Swamishri said, "Maharaj and Swami may come in any form."
The promise Maharaj gave, "At the end, I will surely come for my devotees...", he is still keeping today through Swamishri.
